== deploy/release-notes-6.24.0-4314.md
1 # Release notes: billing-svc build 6.24.0-4314
2 
3 Previous build: 6.23.4. Defaults below override repository config files.
4 
5 - deps: json serializer upgraded
6 - config: `log.level` default remains info
7 - metrics: db pool gauges renamed to `db_pool_*`
8 - logging: structured request ids added to access logs
9 - clients: default `clients.pricing-core.timeout_ms` lowered from 2500 to 800 (fail fast)
10 - docs: runbook links updated
11 - tracing: sampling rate default 1% (unchanged)
12 - health: readiness probe timeout 2s (unchanged)
13 - locale: currency formatting fixes
14 - build: container base image refreshed
15 - scheduler: cron jitter added to cleanup job
16 - metrics: new histogram for cache hit latency
17 - cache: default `cache.ttl_s` unchanged (120)
18 - db: default connection pool `db.pool.max_size` lowered from 48 to 10 to fit the shared-db connection quota
19 - feature flags: `ff-legacy-export` removed (was 0%)
20 - deps: http client library upgraded to a patch release
21 - batching: max batch size default 200 (unchanged)
22 - api: `/v1/status` returns build id
== ops/oncall-notes.md
1 # On-call notes - billing-svc incident 2031-04-19
2 
3 Informal running notes. Not reviewed; may be out of date.
4 
5 - 08:30 front-proxy 5xx for billing-svc since build 6.24.0-4314 rolled out. Many pricing-core timeouts.
6 - 08:40 Suspect the pricing-core timeout default change in 6.24.0-4314; asking for a mitigation.
